title: Sources: Saints, LB Elliss reunite on 3-year deal

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Sources: Saints, LB Elliss reunite on 3-year deal
sources.description: The Saints have agreed to a three-year, $33 million deal with linebacker Kaden Elliss, according to NFL Network. Originally drafted by New Orleans, Elliss has spent the past three seasons with the Falcons.
